fn safe_div(a: Int, b: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires true
  ensures (b == 0 and result == None) or (b != 0 and result == Some(a / b))
  effects pure
  example safe_div(7, 2) == Some(3)
  example safe_div(-7, 2) == Some(-4)
  example safe_div(5, 0) == None
  example safe_div(0, 5) == Some(0)
{
  if b == 0 then None else Some(a / b)
}
